blocks.content: Quiz: What is the purpose of the partialize option in Zustand persist middleware?
Tap an option below to answer:
It splits the store into multiple files
partialize has nothing to do with files. It selects which state to save.
partialize has nothing to do with files. It selects which state to save.
It selects which parts of the store to save to localStorage
Correct! partialize lets you choose exactly which pieces of state get saved. You only persist what makes sense — like theme and searchQuery, not entries or loading state.
Correct! partialize lets you choose exactly which pieces of state get saved. You only persist what makes sense — like theme and searchQuery, not entries or loading state.
It compresses the stored data to save space
partialize does not compress data. It just filters which state gets saved.
partialize does not compress data. It just filters which state gets saved.
It prevents certain actions from running on page load
partialize does not affect actions. It only controls what state gets persisted.
partialize does not affect actions. It only controls what state gets persisted.
